question: CSideMenuAir and CSideMenuNaval, the sidebar_air and sidebar_naval windows of tfh/interface/sidebar.gui, and their rows: which bases and units are listed and in what order, what basebrowse_entry's name and size show, what unitbrowse_entry's name, location, counter, expand and select_frame do, the tooltips, and when the lists are made again.

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir::CSideMenuAir
addresses.comment: **The air side menu** (0x2C bytes, operator new at 0x65A1F0 in CInGameIdler::CInGameIdler, the one caller, 0x65A20E). CSideMenu's constructor (0x823E90) with the window name `sidebar_air` and no mouse observer (its fourth argument 0, so +0x28 stays null), then its own vftable. `ret 4`; the object arrives in ESI. CSideMenuNaval has no constructor of its own: the same three steps are inlined in CInGameIdler::CInGameIdler at 0x65A0ED-0x65A154 with `sidebar_naval`. In that constructor the menus are made provinces, army, naval, air, deploy in that order. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section C.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824C20-0x824C9A: `push 0xb; push 0x15dfe9c ('sidebar_air')`, the call to 0x823E90 with (esi, [ebp+8], &name, 0), `mov [esi], 0x15dfeac` (CSideMenuAir's table per the RTTI export), `ret 4`. findRefs --callers 0x824C20: one call, 0x65A20E, after `push 0x2c` and operator new. The naval inline: 0x65A0ED push 0x2c, 0x65A109 'sidebar_naval', 0x65A137 call 0x823E90, 0x65A14E `mov [esi], 0x15e0444` (CSideMenuNaval's table). Wrong if 0x15DFEAC is not CSideMenuAir's table.

addresses.signature: CSideMenuAir* __thiscall CSideMenuAir::~CSideMenuAir(CSideMenuAir* this, unsigned int flags)
addresses.comment: Slot 1: puts back its own table, runs CSideMenu's destructor body (0x823F90) and frees the object when bit 0 of the flags is set. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824CA0-0x824CC4: `mov [esi], 0x15dfeac; call 0x823f90; test byte [ebp+8],1; ... call 0xb95f9b (operator delete)`, `ret 4`. vtable.py: CSideMenuAir slot 1 = 0x824CA0.

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir::Rebuild
addresses.comment: Slot 0, the reloadable-interface rebuild: CSideMenu's slot 0 (0x824070 - the window destroyed and made again from its type, shown again if it was shown), then CSideMenuAir_BuildList. Returns 1. The name follows the views' slot 0 (CProvinceView::Rebuild).
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824CD0-0x824CE1: `call 0x824070; push esi; call 0x825080; mov al,1; ret`. vtable.py: CSideMenuAir slot 0 = 0x824CD0, CSideMenu slot 0 = 0x824070. What 0x824070 does is reader B's (the frame); read here only far enough to see it ends in slot 2 or slot 3 by the shown state it saved.

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir::Show
addresses.comment: Slot 2: shows the window (+0x24, the slot 13 of its sub-object at +0x18, which CSideMenu's own slot 2 at 0x824100 jumps to) and **makes the list** (CSideMenuAir_BuildList). Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824CF0-0x824D08: `mov ecx,[esi+0x24]; mov eax,[ecx+0x18]; mov edx,[eax+0x34]; add ecx,0x18; call edx; push esi; call 0x825080; ret`. The same three instructions are the whole of CSideMenu slot 2 (0x824100, a `jmp edx`). vtable.py: CSideMenuAir slot 2 = 0x824CF0.

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir::Update
addresses.comment: **Slot 7, and the menu's whole behaviour while it is open.** First what CSideMenu's slot 7 does (the mouse observer at +0x28 told, its slot 1 - null for this menu). Then `unit_queue` (the window's FindListBox) is asked how many rows it holds and CSideMenuAir_CountRows how many it should hold: **when they differ the list is made again whole** (CSideMenuAir_BuildList); when they agree each row is asked to update itself (its slot 8 - for a unit's row CAirUnitBrowserEntry::Update, which only enables or disables `expand`; for a base's row the empty default). So the list is made again only when the count of rows changes - a unit gained, lost or expanded - and **a row's text is never refreshed**: a unit that moves keeps its old `location` until something changes the count.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824D10-0x824E48: `cmp [esi+0x28],0 / call [vt+4]`; 'unit_queue' and window slot 0x7C (31, CFixedWindow::FindListBox); listbox slot 0x2C then `[eax+8]` (the entries count) compared with `call 0x824FF0`; unequal -> `call 0x825080`; equal -> walks the entries CList (`[eax]` head, `[node+8]` next) calling each row's `[vt+0x20]` (slot 8). The two slot 8 bodies the rows can have: 0x8249B0 (unit rows) and 0xABF890 (the 1691-slot empty stub, base rows). Wrong if listbox slot 11's `+8` is not the row count - but the same comparison is CSideMenuDeploy::Update's, recorded from the other side.

addresses.name: SideMenu_CountUnitRows
addresses.signature: int __stdcall SideMenu_CountUnitRows(void* menu@ECX, CList* units@stack:4, int depth@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment: How many rows a list of units makes in the air or naval side menu: one for each unit, plus, for a unit whose `outliner_expanded` (CUnit +0xB4) is set, what its `children` (+0x1E4) make one level deeper, recursively. At depth 0 a unit with a parent (+0x1E0) is skipped - but both menus call it at depth 2 only, so that test never applies. `ret 8`; ECX is the menu, only passed down. **Shared by the two menus**: the linker kept the air copy and CSideMenuNaval_CountRows calls it too (0x829BCE), so the name is class-free.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824E50-0x824EA3: walks `[list]`/`[node+8]`; `test ebx,ebx / cmp [eax+0x1e0],ebx` skips only at depth 0; `inc edi`; `cmp byte [eax+0xb4],0` then recurses with `lea ecx,[ebx+1]` and `eax+0x1e4`; `ret 8`. findRefs --callers: 0x824E90 (itself), 0x82505E (air count), 0x829BCE (naval count). CUnit +0xB4, +0x1E0, +0x1E4 are recorded fields (outliner_expanded, higher_oob_unit_ptr, children).

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir::AddUnitRows
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CSideMenuAir::AddUnitRows(CSideMenuAir* this, GuiListBox* list, CList* units, int depth)
addresses.comment: Adds a CAirUnitBrowserEntry (0x100 bytes) to `unit_queue` for each unit of the list, in the list's order, and straight after an expanded unit (CUnit +0xB4 outliner_expanded) the rows of its children (+0x1E4), recursively. The depth is not handed to the row and nothing indents it - `browser_offset` is not read by either menu (it is by CBrowserItem and CUnitBrowserEntry, reader B's). At depth 0 a unit with a parent is skipped, but the menu calls it at depth 1, so every unit on the base's list gets a row, **whoever's it is**: there is no test of the owner. `ret 0xC`. The row is added through the list's slot 4 with 1.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824EB0-0x824FED: `push 0x100; call 0xb9602f`, the inlined CCurrentGameState get-or-create ([0x1A89790]), `call 0x824500` with (row, state->in_game_screen +0xBE8, this, unit), `call [list_vt+0x10]` with (row, 1), the expanded test and the recursion with depth+1 at 0x824FCF. No read of the unit's owner (+0x124/+0x128) anywhere in the body. browser_offset: its string at 0x15D9F8C is referenced only at 0x7755F8 and 0x8259B3 (findValue), inside CBrowserItem slot 8 (0x7753C0) and CUnitBrowserEntry slot 8 (0x8258A0) - the positive control that the search sees a use.

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir_CountRows
addresses.comment: How many rows the air menu should have: for each province of the player's `AirBases` (CCountry +0xD70), one for the base and one for each unit on its base object's list (CMapProvince +0x54 -> +4), plus SideMenu_CountUnitRows(children, 2) for each expanded unit. The player is the in-game screen's slot 23 (GetPlayer), indexed into the country database at [0x1A855A4] +0x16C. `ret 4`. What Update compares the list's count with.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824FF0-0x825077: `call [screen_vt+0x5c]`, `mov ecx,[0x1a855a4]+0x16c; [ecx+eax*4]` with the returned id; `[edx+0xd70]`, per node `[eax+0x54]` then `[ecx+4]`; `push 2` before 0x824E50; `ret 4`. +0xD70 is the Lua API's AirBases (CCountry::GetAirBases), +0x54 home_base_ptr (a CUnitBaseProvince, its unit list at +4).

addresses.name: CSideMenuAir_BuildList
addresses.comment: **Makes the air menu's list.** Empties `unit_queue` (its slot 23), then for each province of the player's `AirBases` (CCountry +0xD70), in that list's own order: a CAirBaseBrowserEntry (0x38 bytes) for the province, and CSideMenuAir::AddUnitRows(the province's base object +0x54 -> +4, depth 1) - every unit based at that air base, in the base's own order, with an expanded unit's children under it. So the list is air bases, each followed by the units based there; **an air unit on a carrier is in no row**, because a carrier's base is a CUnitBaseCarrier and no province's, and a unit is listed under its home base wherever it is now. The title `title_view_air` is never set (the string is not in the image), so it shows the file's own `text = "Air Units"`. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x825080-0x82524B: 'unit_queue', FindListBox (window slot 0x7C), `call [list_vt+0x5c]`; player country as in CountRows; `[eax+0xd70]` walk; `push 0x38; call 0xb9602f`; `call 0x824200` with (row, state->+0xBE8, menu, province); `call [list_vt+0x10]` (row, 1); `mov ecx,[esi+0x54]; add ecx,4; push 1` then `call 0x824eb0`. title_view_air: image.findBytes finds no such string, where the same search finds title_view_deploy with two references (0x827E7E, 0x828801) - the positive control.

addresses.name: _A0xaec99346::CAirBaseBrowserEntry::CAirBaseBrowserEntry
addresses.signature: _A0xaec99346::CAirBaseBrowserEntry* __stdcall _A0xaec99346::CAirBaseBrowserEntry::CAirBaseBrowserEntry(_A0xaec99346::CAirBaseBrowserEntry* this, CInGameIdler* screen, CSideMenuAir* menu, CMapProvince* province)
addresses.comment: **An air base's row**, window `basebrowse_entry`, 0x38 bytes. Keeps the province at +0x34. `name` is the province's name (its sub-object at +8, slot 7). **`size` is the air base's working level over its built level**: `FormatFixedPoint(air_base->level_current (+0x24), 2) + "/" + level_max (+0x20) / 1000` - e.g. `4.50/5` for a level 5 base bombed to 4.5. It is not a count of units and not a capacity. Both are written once, here; the row has no update of its own (slot 8 is the empty stub) and no click (slot 4 is the 85-table default that only marks the option chosen).
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824200-0x8244FB: 'basebrowse_entry' to 0x824140; `[ebx+0x34]=[ebp+0x14]`; vftable 0x15DFF6C (CAirBaseBrowserEntry); 'name': `[ecx+8]` slot 0x1C into the instant text box (window slot 0x3C, 15, FindInstantTextBox) through 0x401BD0 and 0xB32880; 'size': `[prov+0x304]` (air_base) `+0x20` times 0x10624DD3 >> 6 (/1000) into _itoa base 10 (0xB9A0C4), `+0x24` into FormatFixedPoint (0xA5ACA0) with 2, the literal at 0x15B5180 is "/", and two std::string::operatorPlus (0xA5B0D0): fixed + "/" then + integer. vtable.py: slots 4 and 8 of CAirBaseBrowserEntry are 0xA7F7B0 and 0xABF890.

Two button glues (VCAirUnitBrowserEntry::__CButtonObserverGlue, 0x825250): +0x38 on `expand` with CAirUnitBrowserEntry::OnExpandClicked, +0x88 on `select_frame` with the slot-4 thunk 0x67A310 (OnSelect). The table: 0->5, 1->4, 2->3, 3->2, 4->(brigades>1), 5->1, 6->0, the recorded CUnit::GetCounterSize.

addresses.name: _A0xaec99346::CAirUnitBrowserEntry::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 8 of both unit rows, air and naval - **one body the linker kept from the air unit**, which CNavalUnitBrowserEntry's table holds too and its constructor calls (0x82973A). Resolves the row's unit (CRef_ResolveAndCache on +0xD8); where it still exists, `expand` is **disabled** (button slot 47) when the unit has no children (children_count +0x1EC == 0) and enabled (slot 46) otherwise. Its `>` text never changes with the expanded state. Nothing else of the row is refreshed.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x8249B0-0x824A89: `lea esi,[edi+0xd8]; call 0x42de10`; `cmp [eax+0x1ec],ebx; jne`; FindButton 'expand' then `[vt+0xbc]` (zero children) or `[vt+0xb8]`; the record's reading of button slots 46 enable / 47 disable (CDiplomacyView::Update, CWarGoalDialog). vtable.py --holding 0x8249B0: CAirUnitBrowserEntry slot 8 and CNavalUnitBrowserEntry slot 8, nothing else. findRefs --callers: 0x82495A (air constructor), 0x82973A (naval constructor).

addresses.name: _A0xaec99346::CAirUnitBrowserEntry::OnExpandClicked
addresses.comment: `expand`'s click, for the air and the naval unit rows alike (the naval constructor hands the same address to its glue, 0x82934D). Resolves the row's unit by its id (+0xDC/+0xE0, FindPersistentById inlined, the result less 8) into +0xD8 and **flips its `outliner_expanded` (CUnit +0xB4) - the same flag the outliner's expand_button flips**, so expanding a unit here expands it in the outliner and the other way round. The menu's next Update finds the row count changed and makes the list again with or without the children. Bare `ret`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x824A90-0x824B4A: two inlined resolutions of `[esi+0xdc]/[esi+0xe0]` through 0xA9DA00 on [0x1A857F0] or [0x1A857F4] by `cmp eax,0x1268`, `add eax,-8`, `mov [esi+0xd8],eax`; `cmp byte [eax+0xb4],0; sete cl; mov [eax+0xb4],cl`; bare ret. The handler address is the `mov eax,0x824a90` before the glue at +0x38 in both constructors (0x82456D, 0x82934D). Not in any virtual table (vtable.py --holding answers none).

addresses.name: _A0xaec99346::CAirUnitBrowserEntry::OnSelect
addresses.comment: Slot 4 of both unit rows, air and naval (one body), reached from `select_frame` through the slot-4 thunk 0x67A310. Resolves the row's unit by its id (into +0xD8) and, where it exists, has the menu's in-game screen (+0x30 -> +0x20) **clear the selection (slot 46, ClearSelection) and select the unit (slot 38, Select)**. The map is not centred and no window opened. Whether a click on the row's background also reaches slot 4 is the list's and was not read.

slots_noted: Three unit-row bodies are one function for the air and the naval row (ICF across the two anonymous namespaces): 0x4249B0 (slot 8) and 0x424B50 (slot 4) sit in the air translation unit and are named for CAirUnitBrowserEntry; 0x429790 (slot 0) and 0x429E40 (slot 0 at +0x1C) sit in the naval one and are named for CNavalUnitBrowserEntry. Each is recorded in both classes' slot tables under the same slot name. The base rows and the parents CAirBrowserEntry/CNavalBrowserEntry hold only shared CStandardlistboxItem bodies (0x71E820 in 27 tables, 0xA7F7B0 in 85, 0xABF890 the empty stub) and get no record. CSideMenuAir/Naval slots 3-6 and 8 are CSideMenu's (slot 4 IsShown already recorded; 6 is the 192-table `xor al,al; ret 4`, 8 EmptyTooltip) - reader B's frame.
